fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Addendum corrections override catalogue or property-page labels when the records conflict.
Seller allowances, rent-free periods, gross/net income and headline rent are kept distinct.
Future rent reviews, options, holding-over outcomes and proposed lettings are not silently resolved.
Planning, conversion, redevelopment and overage potential remain subject to consents and legal terms.
Receiver, administration, dissolved-tenant, inaccessible-area and physical-condition caveats are preserved.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current Companies House status.
